This is a minor geometric inconsistency. The animal_pose_auditor's high risk level (65% low confidence keypoints) strongly supports the visual finding of anatomical ambiguity in the hand/finger structure, even if the specific keypoints (face/shoulders) are irrelevant to the visible finger. The low confidence in the wrist/elbow area correlates with the ambiguous connection of the finger to the rest of the hand.
